notes: Torah #230 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in torahData.js. The dataset contains no edges at all for reference=230. The packages file also contains zero packages. The Torah teaches that one with spiritual eyes can recognize a student's teacher from the student's face, because 'a person's wisdom illuminates his face' (Ecclesiastes 8:1) — the student receives his teacher's wisdom and thereby receives his teacher's face. The causal chain is: teacher's wisdom -> illuminates teacher's face -> student receives wisdom -> student receives face-imprint -> observer can identify the teacher. This is pure eitza structure, but none was encoded in the dataset.
